name: Aura Study
body:
Despite your fixation on alternative tactics, you can still command the aura of a legend.

Prerequisite(s): Reduced commander’s aura class feature.

Benefit(s): Select 1 aura you would normally gain from the commander’s aura class feature except for destructive counsel, instantly gaining access to it.

Special: You can select this feat more than once, each time selecting a different aura.
